items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 4 ACs implemented (reasoning-effort argv, distinctness fixture, transport_note evidence incl. override reflection, Claude dispatch untouched); TOML generator explicitly out of scope per Architecture Review + user decision, not shipped.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No new system boundaries; existing subprocess OSError/TimeoutExpired handling in codex_review_transport.py is unchanged by this diff.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input reaches SQL/HTML; no new secrets; env allowlist/scrub unchanged; model slug still validated before launch.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert on outcomes (argv content, reviews.json row content) not implementation; happy-path, plan_review-absence, and explicit-override paths all covered; exact-set and full-argv-snapshot tests added post external review.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Pure CLI/dispatch code -- no DB, loops, or pagination surface.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Follows existing lib/tools/tests layout; codex_review_transport.py holds exactly at its 300-line cap after careful trimming.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: transport_note is new evidence written into reviews.json (producer: run_codex_review + record_review_pass.py; consumer: record_review_pass.py show / webui). Round-trip covered end-to-end by the AC2 distinctness fixture (produce -> record -> show).
